enchantments.tooltip: Acid Absorption +34%: Passive: 34% Enhancement Bonus to Acid Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Insightful Constitution +6: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Constitution.

Feat: Wind Through The Trees: When enemies hit or miss you, they have a 5% chance to be knocked down with no save. This may only trigger once every 12 seconds, and shares a cooldown with the Wind through the Trees feat.
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
